name: Jäckvik-Adolfström
description: Jäckvik to Adolfström. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Pieljekaisestugan spring: Cold spring next to Pieljekaisestugan.
notes: STF and Naturkartan say 22 km. Naturkartan GPX computes about 20.435 km, WFS about 20.994 km, OSM about 20.926 km, AllTrails 20.4 km and Komoot 21.1 km. Sweden's National Parks activity page says about 27 km.
STF gives 9-10 h; Naturkartan sub-stages total 7-10 h; app tracks are closer to 6-7.5 h moving time.

WFS/Naturkartan section-18 starts at Pieljekaise trailhead around 66.38349,16.9604. OSM relation starts at Jäckvik village/service endpoint 66.3889994,16.9665137, about 670 m away. Section 17 Naturkartan endpoint is about 903-905 m from section-18 WFS/Naturkartan endpoint.
Official trail sources use Adolfström; Lantmäteriet returned Adolfsström.
Pieljekaise overlap is expected; Laisdalens fjällurskog overlap at the south end was identified by rules lane. Hornavan-Sädvajaure is nearby but does not intersect selected line.

Many facilities are official/Naturkartan-backed, but start-village services duplicate section 17 endpoint records; bridge display taxonomy may not support all bridge records; some camps/viewpoints are OSM-only or prose-inferred.
Before runtime import, decide geometry source policy: WFS summer LED primary versus Naturkartan GPX/API versus OSM relation, and document source/licensing constraints.

facilities.name: Pieljekaisestugan
facilities.description: Cabin on Kungsleden with open day room and locked four-bed overnight room. Key via ICA Nära Jäckvik/Handlar'n or Handelsboden in Adolfström. No waste collection. Separate stove/firewood/woodshed should be merged into this cabin record, not imported as standalone outdoor fireplace.

facilities.name: Raststuga Pieljekaise, outside national park
